## Episode Thesis

This is a macro interview with World Bank COO Anna Bjerde, recorded six months after the Strait of Hormuz closed. It covers the World Bank's June forecast of global growth slowing to 2.5% (with a downside case of 1.3%), about $60bn of crisis support that could rise to $100bn, and energy markets adapting faster than in past oil shocks. It also covers the positive outlook for AI in developing economies and support for Ukraine, along with rising wheat futures on escalation fears. The only company named is sponsor Société Générale, and no stock view is given.
